planlar.kadraj: extreme close-up of a smartphone lying face-up on a wooden nightstand, the phone in the upper-middle of the vertical frame, a sleeping couple in the bed behind it completely out of focus as soft dark shapes
planlar.tarif: the phone screen has just lit up and casts cold blue-white light on the nightstand surface and on a glass of water, the screen content itself is a plain glowing rectangle (UI will be added in post), the couple breathes peacefully under grey linen bedding, everything else in blue-black darkness
planlar.ek_negatif: readable text on phone screen, visible logos
planlar.animasyon: the phone screen lights up from black to cold blue-white over 0.3 seconds; very subtle breathing motion of the blurred sleepers in the background; light from the screen gently spills on the nightstand; no other movement
planlar.kamera: Sabit. Ekran yanınca %2 ileri kayma (dolly-in), 4 sn boyunca. · static, then 2% push-in over 4s
planlar.teknik: Görsel + After Effects: ekran ışığı ayrı katman (opacity animasyonu), arka plan nefes için hafif ölçek (101%) döngüsü. UI grafiği montajda.

planlar.kadraj: wide shot at eye level from the far east end of the corridor looking west toward the front door, the thermostat on the LEFT wall in the left-middle of the frame
planlar.tarif: the thermostat display glowing blue-white is the main light source, the light oak shoe cabinet stands against the left wall in the middle of the corridor directly under the lowered ceiling, the hatch edge in the lowered ceiling is barely perceptible and must not draw attention, the louvered boiler closet and bathroom door on the right wall in deep shadow, faint cold street light leaking through the frosted glass of the living room door on the left
planlar.animasyon: almost no motion; the thermostat display glow pulses imperceptibly; faint dust particles drift in the thermostat light; the whole image slowly pushes toward the thermostat
planlar.kamera: Termostata doğru çok yavaş ileri kayma, 5 sn'de %6. · very slow dolly-in toward the thermostat, 6% over 5s
planlar.teknik: Görsel + 2.5D parallax (ön plan duvarlar / orta plan ayakkabılık / arka plan kapı ayrı katmanlar). Toz partikülü AE'de.
planlar.grafik: Son 1,5 sn sonrası: beyaza kesme, başlık kartı YEDEK ANAHTAR (ayrı grafik, bkz. B1-S02-T)

planlar.tarif: Beyaz zemin (#E8E4DC), ortada ince, aralıklı (tracking +200) gri (#5C6773) büyük harfler: YEDEK ANAHTAR. Animasyon yok, sert giriş ve sert çıkış.

planlar.kadraj: tall vertical wide shot from across the street, slight low angle, the two characters small in the lower third of the frame, the full four-storey building facade above them reaching to the top of the frame
planlar.tarif: moving day: MERT, also wearing his dark navy wool overcoat over the hoodie, carries a large cardboard moving box toward the entrance door, AYLA stands holding a potted plant and looks up at the top floor, a few cardboard boxes on the wet cobblestones, the top floor windows on the LEFT half of the facade are dark and curtainless, the corner shop across with its shutter down
planlar.ek_negatif: moving truck logo, readable shop sign, crowds
planlar.animasyon: Mert walks two steps toward the door carrying the box; Ayla slowly raises her head to look up at the top floor; a gull crosses the sky; light drizzle
planlar.kamera: Yavaş yukarı tilt: alt üçte birdeki karakterlerden en üst kattaki sol pencerelere, 8 sn. · slow tilt up from characters to top-floor left windows over 8s
planlar.teknik: Uzun dikey görsel (1080×3200 eşdeğeri) üretip AE'de yukarı kaydırma (tilt simülasyonu). Karakterler ayrı katmanda, sınırlı animasyon (yürüyüş 2 poz döngüsü, baş kaldırma 3 ara kare).

planlar.kadraj: insert close-up from above of AYLA's open right palm (silver ring on index finger, ink smudges on fingertips) receiving a key ring from an older man's hand entering from the top of the frame (only HIKMET's hand and beige trench coat cuff visible, gold signet ring on his LEFT little finger)
planlar.tarif: the three keys rest in her palm, the old worn brass key on top, the tiny stamped letters on it catch the light but are not emphasized, background is the blurred terrazzo landing
planlar.ek_negatif: extra fingers, wrong hand, readable large text
planlar.animasyon: the man's hand releases the keys which settle into her palm with a small bounce; her thumb slowly turns the brass key once; his hand withdraws upward
planlar.teknik: El animasyonu elle ara kare (6–8 kare). Kenan dışı karakter elleri yine de 03c el kuralıyla kontrol edilecek.

planlar.kadraj: medium close-up of HIKMET framed on the right side of the vertical frame, his eyes NOT looking at the camera or at Ayla but at the door frame of apartment 7 beside him
planlar.tarif: his polite closed-lip smile, prayer beads in his RIGHT hand at chest height, harsh bare bulb top light leaving his eye sockets in shadow, dark green lower wall behind him
planlar.ek_negatif: looking at camera, warm friendly expression
planlar.animasyon: his lips move for a short line (4 words); the prayer beads click forward one by one in his right hand; his eyes shift once toward the door frame; very slight handheld drift
planlar.kamera: Çok hafif el kamerası titreşimi (±0,5%). · very slight handheld drift
planlar.teknik: Dudak senkronu: 'Alttakini boş verin. Eski.' (2 sn). Tespih: 4 kare döngü.

planlar.kadraj: over-the-shoulder shot from behind AYLA (back of her head and parka hood in the left foreground, out of focus) toward the door of apartment 8 across the landing
planlar.tarif: the dark walnut door marked 8 is open only a few centimeters, held by a brass door chain, through the narrow gap warm honey-yellow light from inside spills onto the cold landing
planlar.animasyon: Ayla turns her head slightly toward the door; the warm light in the gap flickers subtly
planlar.kamera: Kapı aralığına doğru çok yavaş ileri kayma, %4. · slow push-in toward the door gap
planlar.teknik: 2.5D: Ayla ön plan katmanı, kapı arka plan.

planlar.kadraj: close-up through the chained door gap: only a vertical strip of SAADET's face is visible — one eye magnified behind a thick glasses lens, part of her wrinkled cheek, the yellow measuring tape at her neck, the brass chain crossing the frame
planlar.tarif: she does not smile, her gaze is steady and heavy, warm yellow light behind her, the cold landing light on the door edge
planlar.animasyon: her lips move for one short sentence (7 words); after the line the door slowly closes and the strip of face disappears into the dark wood
planlar.teknik: Dudak senkronu: 'Kaloriferi kısma kızım. Bu ev soğuğu sevmez.' (3 sn). Kapı kapanışı: kapı katmanının 1,5 sn yatay kayması.

planlar.kadraj: wide shot of the living room from the corridor doorway, the north windows at the back of the frame
planlar.tarif: moving boxes everywhere, AYLA pushes the bottle-green velvet armchair into place IN FRONT OF THE WINDOW, the four faded dark dents in the parquet in front of the bookshelf on the west wall are visible at the bottom edge of the frame but NOT emphasized
planlar.ek_negatif: armchair in front of the bookshelf
planlar.animasyon: Ayla gives the armchair a final push and steps back to look at it; dust in the window light
planlar.teknik: Sınırlı animasyon: itme 4 poz.

planlar.kadraj: medium shot of MERT kneeling by the bookshelf with a cordless drill, profile view
planlar.tarif: he concentrates on fixing a shelf bracket, screws between his lips, boxes around him
planlar.animasyon: the drill spins briefly; Mert adjusts the bracket
planlar.teknik: Sınırlı animasyon.

planlar.kadraj: medium close-up two-shot in the kitchen in the early morning, both standing at the counter
planlar.tarif: AYLA presses two fingers against her temple with her eyes squinting, MERT dressed for 'work' drinks a glass of water and rubs his forehead, both look tired, cold grey morning light from the courtyard window
planlar.animasyon: Ayla rubs her temple in a slow circle; Mert lowers the glass and speaks two words
planlar.teknik: Dudak senkronu (Mert): 'Boya kokusu.' (1 sn).

planlar.kadraj: insert shot of the mug on the grey countertop, centered, at counter height
planlar.tarif: the cream mug with the thin navy rim has its cracked handle pointing to the LEFT, pale overcast morning light from the window, white subway tiles out of focus behind
planlar.animasyon: completely still; only the faint drifting light of passing clouds
planlar.teknik: Tek görsel, hafif ışık animasyonu.

planlar.kadraj: full-frame insert of an open sketchbook page, top-down
planlar.tarif: a precise pencil drawing of the same kitchen counter from yesterday, the same mug drawn with its handle pointing to the RIGHT, small handwritten date in the corner (illegible), clean graphite linework on off-white paper
planlar.ek_negatif: handle pointing left, colored drawing, readable text
planlar.animasyon: still; a tiny flutter of the page edge
planlar.teknik: Çizim bölümü gerçek kurşun kalem dokusunda (Ayla'nın çizim stili: temiz, mimari). Tarih grafiği montajda.

planlar.kadraj: close-up of AYLA's right hand (silver ring, ink smudges) turning the mug handle back to the right
planlar.tarif: only the hand, the cardigan sleeve cuff and the mug in frame, the hand stops and rests on the mug for a moment
planlar.animasyon: the hand rotates the mug 180 degrees smoothly, then rests still for one second
planlar.kamera: Elin hareketini izleyen hafif yatay kayma. · slight follow pan
planlar.teknik: Elle ara kare (8 kare).

planlar.kadraj: wide shot from the front door looking east down the corridor
planlar.tarif: the light oak shoe cabinet has been dragged from beside the door to the middle of the corridor against the LEFT (north) wall, exactly under the lowered ceiling, AYLA stands next to it with one hand on its top, MERT in his navy overcoat and backpack walks past her toward the camera and the front door without looking at her, the thermostat on the left wall further back
planlar.animasyon: Mert walks toward camera and exits frame left at the door; Ayla stays still touching the cabinet; Mert's lips move for two words as he passes
planlar.teknik: Mert yürüyüşü 6 poz, dudak senkronu: 'Sen çekmişsindir.' (1 sn).

planlar.kadraj: insert of the oak herringbone parquet close to the floor
planlar.tarif: two fresh pale scrape lines in the parquet varnish lead from the entrance area to the base of the shoe cabinet
planlar.animasyon: still; dust settles in a thin light beam
planlar.teknik: Tek görsel.

planlar.kadraj: POV looking straight up at the low white corridor ceiling at 2.10 m
planlar.tarif: a plain white painted ceiling surface with a very faint, almost invisible square seam and the softest grey shadow along it, the beam line where the ceiling rises to 3.10 m at the top edge of frame
planlar.animasyon: the image tilts upward slowly from the wall to the ceiling and holds one beat too long on the ceiling
planlar.kamera: Yavaş yukarı tilt, tavanda 1,5 sn fazla kalma. · slow tilt up, hold on ceiling 1.5s
planlar.teknik: Duvar+tavan tek uzun görsel, AE'de dikey kaydırma.

planlar.kadraj: wide shot of the study wall covered with a grid of twelve pinned pencil sketches (four days × three rooms), AYLA at the right edge of the frame half turned away, wearing her round reading glasses
planlar.tarif: warm desk lamp light mixed with cold daylight from the south window, the sketches show the corridor, the kitchen and the living room from the same angles day after day
planlar.animasyon: slow lateral drift along the sketch wall; Ayla draws a red circle on one sketch
planlar.kamera: Duvar boyunca yavaş yatay kayma, 6 sn. · slow lateral pan across the wall
planlar.teknik: Geniş yatay görsel, AE'de kaydırma.

planlar.kadraj: three quick inserts of individual sketches, each filling the frame
planlar.tarif: (1) the mug sketch with the handle circled in red pencil, (2) a chair pushed in under the table circled in red, (3) the shoe cabinet in the middle of the corridor circled in red
planlar.animasyon: each insert holds 1.6 seconds with a micro push-in
planlar.kamera: Her insert'te mikro ileri kayma. · micro push-ins
planlar.teknik: 3 ayrı görsel (B1-S09b-1/2/3).

planlar.kadraj: low angle close to the floor: AYLA on her knees in the foreground taping strips of painter's tape on the parquet around the legs of the green armchair in front of the window; MERT out of focus in the background on the sofa
planlar.tarif: Mert's face lit by his phone screen, the phone shows a blurry job listing website layout (unreadable), a single warm floor lamp, the windows deep blue behind
planlar.animasyon: Ayla tears and presses a strip of tape; Mert lifts his head, looks at her for a second as if to say something, then looks back at his phone; Ayla switches off the floor lamp and the room goes dark blue
planlar.teknik: Lamba kapanışı: iki ışık durumu görseli (AKŞAM → GECE), 2 karede geçiş.

planlar.kadraj: close-up of the thermostat display centered in the frame, everything around it pure black
planlar.tarif: the backlit display shows the digits, cold blue-white glow on a tiny area of wall
planlar.animasyon: the display digits change from 22 to 23 (handled in post); the glow brightens slightly at the moment of change
planlar.teknik: Rakamlar montajda grafik (görselde boş ekran üret).

planlar.kadraj: medium shot of AYLA standing in the living room doorway holding a coffee cup, seen from inside the room
planlar.tarif: she wears pajamas with the ochre cardigan over her shoulders, her face freezes as she looks toward the window
planlar.animasyon: Ayla stops mid-step; the coffee in the cup trembles slightly
planlar.teknik: Sınırlı animasyon.

planlar.kadraj: insert of the parquet in front of the window from slightly above
planlar.tarif: an empty rectangle of painter's tape strips on the floor where the armchair stood, nothing inside it
planlar.animasyon: still; window light slowly shifts
planlar.teknik: Tek görsel.

planlar.kadraj: very low tracking shot along the parquet surface
planlar.tarif: four parallel fresh scrape lines run across the herringbone parquet from the window toward the bookshelf on the west wall
planlar.animasyon: the camera glides low along the scrape lines toward the bookshelf
planlar.kamera: Yerde yavaş takip kayması (dolly), 4 sn. · low tracking dolly following the marks
planlar.teknik: Uzun yatay zemin görseli, AE'de perspektifli kaydırma.

planlar.kadraj: wide shot of the green velvet armchair standing in front of the white bookshelf on the west wall
planlar.tarif: the armchair sits at exactly the same position and angle as in photograph F-1 (the old couple's photo), slightly angled toward the room, the empty tape rectangle by the window visible in the background
planlar.animasyon: still; a faint dust swirl in the light
planlar.teknik: Kompozisyon F-1 fotoğrafıyla eşleşmeli (aynı açı, aynı konum).

planlar.kadraj: extreme close-up at floor level of one armchair leg and AYLA's right hand lifting it
planlar.tarif: under the lifted leg a faded dark round dent in the parquet; the leg is then lowered and fits perfectly into the dent
planlar.animasyon: the hand lifts the leg 3 cm, holds, then lowers it so it drops exactly into the dent with a small settle
planlar.teknik: Elle ara kare, 'tak' sesiyle kare-senkron.

planlar.kadraj: high angle from near the ceiling looking down at AYLA kneeling small by the armchair, the composition continues upward to the open double glass door of the corridor where the low corridor ceiling sits in darkness
planlar.tarif: grey morning light in the living room gradually gives way to the dark corridor in the upper part of the frame
planlar.animasyon: the camera rises and slowly rotates toward the corridor doorway, ending with the dark corridor ceiling filling the upper half of the frame and the top of Ayla's head at the bottom edge
planlar.kamera: Yavaş yükselme ve dönme (crane + pan), 8 sn. · slow crane up + pan toward corridor door
planlar.teknik: Tek uzun dikey görsel + AE kamera; ya da kaba 3D maket üstüne boyama (projection mapping).

planlar.kadraj: close-up of AYLA's face, three-quarter front, kneeling on the floor
planlar.tarif: her expression: frozen fear mixed with realization, lips slightly parted, grey morning light — this frame will be blurred and darkened under the choice card
planlar.animasyon: none (static background under the card); a slow 3% blur increase over the duration
planlar.teknik: Arka plan: görsel %70 karartma + Gauss bulanıklığı 18 px. Üstüne seçim kartı grafiği.
planlar.grafik: AYLA NE YAPMALI? / A — Mert'e söylemeden gizli bir kamera kur. / B — Mert'e her şeyi anlat, bu gece birlikte uyanık kalın. / Yorumlara A ya da B yaz.
